This for example seems like a more narrowed down RQ. However, you seem to have four different (and a bit unrelated apart from the hologram part) research questions

This could be a general research question, and since this is very general, you could have several sub research questions that refine it and look at different perspectives of the RQ. Currently, none of the questions seem precise enough to be answered properly

In a SOTA section, you want to combine these different pieces of literature to "tell a story" instead of just "describing the content". You as the author of the expose should contextualize more, and also focus on strengths/weaknesses of this work, as this lays the foundation for your study
